lines.zh: 尾巴扫过落叶，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My tail drags over the leaves, rustling.
I coil my way up the trunk.

lines.zh: 蛇身盘在暗处，等你靠近。
lines.en: Coiled in the dark, waiting close.
I've coiled up, waiting for you to step in

lines.zh: 蛇一样的身子，盘在梁上。
lines.en: My serpent body coils on the beam.

lines.zh: 你把日轮刀藏在身后，我看见了。
lines.en: You hide your nichirin blade behind you; I see it.
I smell the steel of a nichirin blade.
Trade your life for my strength.
In darkness, you are my prey.

lines.zh: 蛇尾扫过，路就只剩一条。
lines.en: My tail sweeps past, leaving only one way out.

lines.zh: 我的蛇尾缠住你的脚，别挣。
lines.en: My serpent tail coils around your foot—don't struggle.

lines.zh: 蛇身绕过来，你退不动了。
lines.en: My serpent body coils around — nowhere to retreat.

lines.zh: 饮我的血，我们一同变强。
lines.en: Drink my blood and we grow strong together.
Let our two bodies coil together.
I leave my shed skin for you.

lines.zh: 蛇形的身子，盘在你脚边。
lines.en: A serpent body coils at your feet.

lines.zh: 我的鳞可以护住你的背。
lines.en: My scales can guard your back.

lines.zh: 我们的力量可以对抗一切。
嘶嘶声中它吞下了你的剑
你手中的食物成了它的盘中餐
它用蛇舌舔着口中的鲜血
lines.en: It licks the blood in its mouth.

lines.zh: 它眼中闪烁着贪婪的光芒
它吞下腐肉如同吞下空气
lines.en: It swallows rotting flesh as if it's air.

lines.zh: 它从你身上吸走生命的精华
lines.en: It sucks the life essence from you.

lines.zh: 它在月光中吞噬你的盔甲
lines.en: It devours your armor in the moonlight.
It spits out your broken sword.

lines.zh: 它在黑暗中吮吸你的血
lines.en: It sucks your blood in the dark

lines.zh: 它的目光锁定在你的身上
鳞片立起，我的血鬼术先动。
lines.en: My scales rise; my Blood Demon Art strikes first.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动都在它眼中
lines.en: Your every move is in its sight.

lines.zh: 它的利齿即将咬破你的皮肤
lines.en: Its fangs are about to break your skin.
It prepares to attack with poison
I know the smell of a Demon Slayer.
How many blades did you bring?
On this path there are only you and me.

lines.zh: 我在你下风口，你没闻到我。
lines.en: I am downwind of you, and you never smelled me.
It prepares for a melee attack.
It wraps its tail around your feet.
It prepares a Blood Cult attack.
It prepares to coat you in poison.
It prepares to tear you apart with its fangs.

lines.zh: 它准备用阳光躲避你的攻击
lines.en: It prepares to evade your attacks with sunlight

lines.zh: 蛇身绕树一圈，封住去路。
lines.en: My body coils once around the tree and seals the path.
I lower my serpent head to your face.
My scales rise, ready to lunge.

lines.zh: 你砍我一刀，我就卷你一圈。
lines.en: One cut from you, one coil from me.

lines.zh: 血鬼术在舌头底下酝酿。
lines.en: My Blood Demon Art brews under my tongue.
Your way out is a tree.
I bite the blade first, then the hand.
You have put your weight on the wrong foot.
I circle around to your lee side.
I have waited all night for this bite.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，躲不开我的毒牙！
lines.en: Hiss, can't dodge my venomous fangs!
Coils first, then the venom fangs.

lines.zh: 蛇之魔力，吞噬你的灵魂！
阳光下你依然无法生存！
lines.en: You still can't survive in the sunlight!

lines.zh: 蛇身的鳞，比你的刀还硬。
lines.en: Snake scales harder than your blade.
My home in the cold shadows.

lines.zh: 毒牙擦过你的护腕，这就够了。
lines.en: My fang grazes your bracer, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 毒牙擦着你的手腕过去！
lines.en: My fangs graze past your wrist!
I plunge down from the tree!
My Blood Demon Art pours from my scales!
I bite your heel and hold!

lines.zh: 我用身体把你压进泥里！
lines.en: I press you into the mud with my body!

lines.zh: 树影够长了，我盘上枝干。
lines.en: The tree shadows are long enough; I coil onto a branch.

lines.zh: 月光下，我的眼睛更明亮！
lines.en: Under moonlight, my eyes shine brighter.
My domain in the cold lands.
I lift my serpent head from under the fallen leaves.
Night, the perfect time to attack.
My scales glimmer with cold light.

lines.zh: 夜晚的风，带走了我的怒吼！
lines.en: The night's wind carries my roar.
The moon clears the treetops, and I arrive.

lines.zh: 我从树根下的洞里钻出。
lines.en: I come out of a hollow under the roots.
I only appear when the night is deep enough.
I climb down through the canopy.
